text:
I'm also baby army, so not who this is directed toward, but Hybe Boy on YouTube has excellent English-language translations of Lives, interviews, and other stuff going back several years. He's extremely thorough in his translations and adds cultural context and BTS lore where needed. He explains inside jokes or references that would only be known by older army. He's also a rapper himself, so he sometimes adds relevant context about the industry as well. He even describes the foods they eat for those of us unfamiliar with Korean food. There is always something in his videos that I would not pick up on from just watching subtitled lives. As someone who doesn't understand Korean, I like that it's something I can have on in the background or listen to like a podcast when I can't do subtitles. He also does general reactions/recaps of their concerts and current news which is nice for days I don't want to spend so much time scrolling on social media.

Also, I just realized this week that the audio version of their book - Beyond the Story - is available on Spotify
